subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Wisdom
solution:
The correct answer is** "Imbecility."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"wisdom"** means the ability to make sensible decisions and judgements because of your knowledge or experience. ((ज्ञान या अनुभव के आधार पर) विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय लेने की क्षमता, समझदारी, बुद्धिमानी, अक़लमंदी)

 
 
• **Example:*** I don’t see the **wisdom**__ of this plan.*
 
 
 
• The word **'imbecility' **means a stupid person. (मूर्ख व्‍यक्ति)
 __
 
• **Example:** *His **imbecility**__ was evident from his inability to solve even the simplest of problems.*
 
 
 
• *​*So, the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word is **"Imbecility."**
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Competency** means ability or skill.
 
• **Cogency **means the quality of being clear, logical, and convincing.
 
• **Dexterity** means skill and grace in physical movement or in handling difficult situations.
